versions.changelog: Security hardening after the ClawHub scan of 1.1.1: --date is validated as a strict YYYY-MM-DD calendar date before it becomes a journal file name or a Garmin URL segment (closes the path-traversal finding); --log-id is validated as alphanumeric; garminconnect is pinned to 0.3.11 (verified against a live account) instead of an open-ended range; the description states that the skill also reads and deletes entries in the Garmin food log. Replaces 1.1.2, whose bundle accidentally carried Python bytecode.

Address SkillSpector review: privacy disclosure for Garmin cloud upload, explicit list of files/env/credentials/network the skill touches, scoped guidance for read-only Garmin commands instead of a blanket "safe without asking". No code changes.
Pattern cache (dishes with deltas, products from labels), local-first journal with supersede corrections and automatic Garmin cleanup, offline day summaries, day_cutoff. Data outside the install dir.
Initial release: read the Garmin Connect food log (totals, macros, meal slots, entries), add Quick Add entries and delete them. Dry-run by default for all writes. Requires Garmin Connect+.
